name: Camera presets, view cube and orthographic views
body:
# Camera presets

Numpad-style presets (Top, Bottom, Front, Back, Left, Right, Perspective) from the View menu and a small view-cube
overlay in the viewport's corner that shows the current orientation and snaps to a face when clicked. Orthographic
projection for the axis-aligned views needs the renderer's `Camera` to support an orthographic matrix.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27 without the view cube: presets (perspective, front, back, left, right, top, bottom) as a toolbar dropdown and View menu, orthographic toggle, bookmarks 1-9. A clickable view cube is a follow-up card.

questions.text: Should the axis-aligned presets (Top, Front, Side) switch to an orthographic projection, which needs an orthographic path in lantern-renderer-3d's Camera, or stay perspective for now?
questions.recommendation: A: Add orthographic projection to the renderer's Camera and use it for the axis-aligned presets; a level editor's top view is unusable in perspective.
